nodes.label: JWT Authorization (30 days)
nodes.rationale: 30-day token lifetime chosen for user convenience in a closed-group context

nodes.label: Booking Approval Workflow
nodes.rationale: Users submit requests, admin confirms or rejects them; conflict re-checked on confirmation

nodes.label: Mobile-First Design (375px)
nodes.rationale: Target screen width 375px for mobile-first responsive layout

nodes.label: Booking Conflict Detection
nodes.rationale: Conflict checked only against confirmed bookings; re-checked at confirmation time to prevent race conditions

nodes.label: Soft Delete for Halls
nodes.rationale: Halls are soft-deleted via active = 0 flag instead of removal

nodes.label: Auto-Logout on 401
nodes.rationale: On 401 API response, frontend automatically removes token and redirects to /login

nodes.label: Certbot HTTPS
nodes.rationale: PWA requires HTTPS on Android and iOS for installation
